lineage.description: Building footprints and attributes were extracted from OpenStreetMap, a volunteered geographic information system, and compiled by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team. The dataset contains approximately 190.4 thousand buildings with structural metadata including construction type, number of levels, and materials, representing an estimated 12% of total buildings in Costa Rica based on AI-mapped estimates.
